mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with temperatures at 72 degrees. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 64 degrees, and you can rest easy knowing there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers for their various programs, noting that some roles require physical activity. Additionally, remember that road construction begins next Tuesday on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks.
There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, Concerts in the Park today, and the weekly Hop Haus Trivia happening today as well.

In our weekly report, on Wednesday, August 5, police responded to a residence on Whalen Road where they apprehended a man who had fled from officers while they were attempting to serve a probation warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich and decadent Devil's Food Cake. The store is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a scoop before they close.
